name: CI runner host: no ARC listeners — poweredge-xubuntu livespec.ci_listeners.active < 1
description: Value companion to the dead-man: fires when the heartbeat IS arriving from host.name=poweredge-xubuntu but MAX(livespec.ci_listeners.active) over the trailing 20 min is below 1 — host and collector alive, yet not one ARC scale-set listener (ghalistener) is registered, so no repository's gating jobs can be taken. Nine scale sets normally give ~9-10. Deliberately on ci_LISTENERS, not ci_runners: every scale set has minRunners=0, so zero RUNNERS is normal idleness and is never alarmed. A MAX-based value trigger cannot fire on silence; silence is the dead-man's job. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n arc-systems get pods (the *-listener pods); sudo kubectl -n arc-systems logs deploy/arc-gha-rs-controller. Emitter: livespec-dev-tooling ci-runner/observability/ci-runner-heartbeat.sh. livespec-s43svm.20, 2026-08-23.
